infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Clemson RIDES uses your location to center the campus map, shares it on a trip link you send, and attaches GPS when you confirm an SOS.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Clemson RIDES uses the microphone only when you start an audio or video recording during an active ride. The clip stays on this phone.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Clemson RIDES uses the camera only when you start a video recording during an active ride. The clip stays on this phone.
